remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Mrs. Liebman's apartment, Jan. 1946. . . . No signature. Title given by Rosalind Irvine. Owned by Mrs. Charles J. Liebman. Painted 1921. See gallery photo 1–b (from memory –– check with Liebman ptg. or photo.)" Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back: O'K: 'Red Apple, Blue Plate,' 1921. Initials in circle" [not verified]. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photographs, see Appendix III, figures 12, 20. Titled *Red Apple on Black Plate* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
